[attribute-xml-space]
=== `@xml:space` Space

When printing or displaying the associated element, all white space (such as tabs, ordinary spaces, and line breaks) should be preserved.

#### Usage/Remarks
Used to keep explicit formatting, for example, in computer code, ASCII art, or poetry.

#### FIXED (not settable) on elements:  <<element-code,`<code>`>>, 
                  <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>>, 
                  <<element-preformat,`<preformat>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| preserve| White space should be preserved. (This value is fixed and cannot be changed
                        in a document.)
| Restriction| This attribute has a fixed value which may not be changed in the XML document.
|===
#### OPTIONAL (defaults to preserve) on element:  <<element-inline-code,`<inline-code>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| default| Processing system (rather than the XML document) determines whether space is preserved
                        or not.
| preserve| White space should be preserved.
| Default value| preserve
|===
